extracted.name: Salmon Tuna Patties
extracted.description: These easy-to-prep salmon and tuna patties have a milder flavor and a crispy cracker coating that both kids and adults love.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14.75 ounce) can salmon, drained and flaked
2 tablespoons canola oil, or to taste
instruction_lines: Mix salmon, tuna, crushed saltines, and egg together with your hands in a large bowl; shape into 6 patties. Dust patties with flour.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Gently lie patties into hot oil, cover the skillet, and fry until crispy, 10 to 15 minutes per side.
